test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A secret plan, made to do something (usually wrong)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Conspiracy**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One-word substitute for a secret plan made to do something wrong is **Conspiracy**.
 
• **Conspiracy **refers to a secret plan by a group of people to do something unlawful or harmful. (लोगों के एक समूह द्वारा कोई गैरकानूनी या हानिकारक कार्य करने की गुप्त योजना)
 
• The word conspiracy is a noun and is pronounced as kuh n-spir-uh-see.
 
 
• **For example**: *The politician was accused of being involved in a conspiracy to rig the election.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Strategy **refers to a plan of action or policy designed to achieve a major or overall aim. It is not necessarily a secret plan and may not involve any wrongdoing. (किसी प्रमुख या समग्र लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए बनाई गई कार्य योजना या नीति)
 
• **Planning **refers to the process of making plans for something. It is not necessarily a secret plan and may not involve any wrongdoing. (किसी चीज़ के लिए योजना बनाने की प्रक्रिया)
 
• **Conditioning **refers to the process of training or accustoming a person or animal to behave in a certain way. It is not related to a secret plan. (किसी व्यक्ति या जानवर को एक निश्चित तरीके से व्यवहार करने के लिए प्रशिक्षित करने या आदी बनाने की प्रक्रिया)
